verdict.rationale: Each skill ships a SKILL.md whose description states what it does and when to use it. Examples: tdd says to "Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions 'red-green-refactor'"; grilling says "Use when the user wants to stress-test their thinking"; setup says "Run once before first use of the other engineering skills." The aihero.dev catalog also gives a one-line purpose for every listed skill, and a runtime probe confirmed installed SKILL.md frontmatter reads back cleanly. missing for 10: activation triggers evidenced for only a few skills rather than every one (the triage description has no 'use when' clause), no documentation of slash-command vs. auto-activation behavior per skill, and no independent corroboration that the descriptions predict agent behavior accurately.
